summary: DRDGOLD Limited filed a Form 6-K on July 15, 2026, announcing the appointment of Mark Hoffman as an independent non-executive director, effective August 1, 2026. The appointment is described as a normal board addition, with no mention of a departure, forced event, or extraordinary circumstances. Since this is a routine voluntary board augmentation that does not represent an abrupt or forced management change, it does not satisfy the special-situations criteria. Accordingly, this filing is classified as None, reflecting its ordinary governance nature.
